description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Search overdue tax history (체납 내역). Narrow the period with strt_dt/end_dt; without them the NTS default period applies. Only 3 rows come back per page unless you raise page_size.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

name: hometax__tax__overdue__search_history
title: 체납 내역 조회
